summary: Clicking the DFM Ratios formula bar away now keeps it away while you move between User Entry cells.
details: Clicking a highlighted User Entry cell hides the formula bar, and it stays hidden as you click other User Entry cells.
Clicking a cell you have already landed on a second time brings the formula bar back.
Select mode and Edit mode behave the same, and starting a formula with = or pasting one still opens the bar.
